jobs.title: Mechanical & CAM Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
**Manufacturing team · On site in Groningen · Full time**

**The role**

Arc makes jewellery-like precision hardware, a unity of art and function, machined from specialised aluminium alloys and titanium grades. That approach has made Arc one of the fastest growing companies in the Netherlands (Deloitte Technology Fast 50, rank 16).

Quality is non-negotiable, in the materials, in the process and in the machines and tools behind them. We are building a greenfield factory in Groningen and bringing production back from China to the EU. We need a hands-on machining lead who connects rapid prototyping today with mass production tomorrow.

You run our on site 5-axis machining cell from day one: cutting tools, fixturing, CAM programming and milling. Your mission is simple: **one prototype a day**.

**What you are accountable for**

* **One prototype a day:** fresh CAD from Product Design turned into a physical part, overnight where possible. Rapid iteration is the heart of product development
* **The machining cell:** tooling, workholding, CAM and machine upkeep under your control, with procedures written down so the work can be repeated
* **The scale-up business case:** real cycle times, tool life, unit cost and overhead, turned into a clear technical and financial case for growing one cell into an automated multi-machine CNC fleet, together with our automation and robotics team
* **Process specifications for mass production:** more than 100 people and even more machines at our production partner overseas make everything Arc sells today. Your specifications decide what they do and how. They learn from you, and you learn from them

**What you will do**

* **Own machining end-to-end,** from CAM to the finished part
* **Co-develop with Product Design** on every CAD iteration, and hand parts over to our surface finishing engineer in a state ready for polishing and coating
* **Build your own workshop:** a multi-ton 5-axis CNC is already there, and you decide what comes next
* **Learn from the best:** outreach to and visits with machine builders such as Hermle, DMG MORI, Kern, Chiron and SW
* **Work with our machine builder** on the equipment that follows

**Practical terms**

* **Location:** on site in Groningen. You live in the Netherlands or are ready to relocate
* **Team:** Manufacturing, working daily with Product Design, Surface Finishing, and Automation and Robotics
* **Contract:** full time

**How we hire**

* **Apply** with your CV and three short questions. It takes about 15 minutes.
* **Screening email:** five written questions about your career, your strengths and your last managers.
* **Practical exercise** at home, about 90 minutes. AI tools are allowed, as long as you understand every part of your answer, can derive it yourself, and stand behind it as your own best work.
* **Career interview** with the hiring manager, 70 minutes. You start by walking us through your exercise, then we go through your career job by job.
* **Culture interview and references** with former managers, only with your consent. Then an offer. A live case study may come before this step.

You hear back from us at every step, usually within two working days.

**What you bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience programming and operating professional 3-axis and 5-axis CNC milling centres
* End-to-end shop-floor ownership: specifying and buying cutting tools, designing workholding, writing high quality 5-axis CAM programs, and getting parts done
* A strong command of GD&T, cutting dynamics, and cosmetic, burr-free finishes
* A detailed understanding of how an industrial CNC machine works inside
* A BSc or MSc in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent, or a proven hands-on track record in machining instead
* A builder mindset: you enjoy hitting daily prototype targets today while thinking rigorously about unit economics and scale tomorrow
* Fluent English

**Useful, but not essential**

* Designing pneumatic or zero-point fixtures for robotic machine tending and lights-out runs
* Building your own machinery, automation and production systems
* Cosmetic machining standards ahead of polishing and surface coating
* Precision consumer hardware, such as watchmaking or luxury manufacturing
* Mass production: OEE, yield optimisation and cost tracking
* Dutch

We hire on trajectory more than on years. If your scope has grown fast and you can show results, apply even if you do not tick every box.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Eindhoven (Strijp-T) | **Hours:** 40 hours per week | **Employment type:** Direct employment

*We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join the Avular Team!*

At Avular, we believe mobile robotics will help make the world a better place, so our products and services accelerate the creation of new mobile robotic applications that shape a brighter future for all. Our goal is to make robots accessible globally and ensure they add value worldwide in the future. Our robots, both on the ground and in the air, are used across industries, always with our purpose in mind: from agriculture to cleaning and from construction to hospitality.

**YOUR MISSION**

Design and develop lightweight mechanical systems that deliver the required functionality, robustness, cost, and performance. Apply sound construction principles, strength calculations, tolerance stack-up analysis, mechanical systems dynamics, FEM simulation, and knowledge of material properties to substantiate design decisions.

* Translate system and stakeholder needs into measurable requirements for mass, strength and stiffness, robustness, cost, manufacturability and technical risk.
* Develop competing concepts, evaluate them against those criteria, then recommend and defend the preferred solution to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Back up designs with hand calculations, FEM simulation, tolerance stack-up analysis, dynamics and vibration analysis, and material selection.
* Work across the mechanical, electrical, control and manufacturing interfaces, and adapt your design when the best system-level trade-off sits outside the mechanical domain.
* Produce manufacturing-ready documentation (drawings with GD&T, defined tolerances, assembly instructions) so lightweight parts are built and assembled reliably.
* Build and test prototypes, and use the results to refine the design until it is verified.

* **WHAT YOU BRING**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 4+ years of professional experience designing, calculating and testing mechanical systems, including FEM.
* Advanced 3D CAD in Siemens NX, SolidWorks or CATIA, covering large assemblies, interface definition and tolerance specification.
* Fluent in spoken and written English.

**Nice to have**

* Lightweight structures experience from drones, aerospace, automotive or high-tech equipment.
* Experience with composites (e.g. CFRP) and/or design for low-to-mid-volume manufacturing (CNC, sheet metal, injection moulding, additive).
* Siemens NX specifically.

**What to Expect**

The Senior Process Engineer, Battery Pack Remanufacturing, will lead the development, implementation and optimization of high-volume processes that return used battery packs to service. The role owns the full remanufacturing value stream: core receipt and grading, high-voltage discharge and disassembly, diagnostics, module and component repair or replacement, reassembly, end-of-line validation and final release.

Remanufacturing brings challenges that new-build production does not, including wide variation in core condition, varied component histories and dependence on reverse supply chains. The Senior Process Engineer will design robust, safe and cost-effective processes that perform reliably across this variation while supporting a rapid volume ramp. Acting as a technical leader, the incumbent will partner with Battery Engineering, Quality, Service, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Operations to maximize recovery yield, reduce cost per pack and feed remanufacturing insights into future pack designs.

 **What You'll Do**

* Process Development and Capacity Scaling: Lead the design and continuous improvement of disassembly, repair, reassembly and test operations using Lean Manufacturing principles. Drive line balancing, constraint analysis, capital equipment selection and automation of repetitive or hazardous tasks. Manage changes through the Production Change Approval process.
* High-Voltage Safety and Regulatory Compliance: In partnership with EHS, Logistics and Regulatory, establish and enforce procedures for the safe handling, discharge, isolation, storage and transport of high-voltage and damaged battery packs. This includes thermal event prevention, quarantine, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and compliance with hazardous materials and recycling requirements.
* Diagnostics and Disposition: Develop incoming inspection and grading methods, including insulation resistance, isolation and leak testing, cell and module capacity measurement, state-of-health (SOH) assessment, and BMS and contactor functional checks. Define disposition criteria for reuse, repair, remanufacture, component harvesting or recycling.
* Process Documentation and Repair Standards: Author and maintain Manufacturing Instructions, Process Flows, PFMEAs, Control Plans and rework procedures for module replacement, cell balancing, BMS replacement, seal and thermal interface replacement, and re-joining operations.
* Test, Release and Traceability: Define end-of-line test requirements and acceptance criteria with Battery Engineering and Quality. Maintain complete pack, module and component genealogy in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to support warranty, compliance and failure analysis.

Arc makes jewellery-like precision hardware, a unity of art and function. That approach has made Arc one of the fastest growing companies in the Netherlands (Deloitte Technology Fast 50, rank 16).

* **Team:** Manufacturing, working daily with Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, and Automation and Robotics

* A rigorous safety mindset around acids, alkalis and hydrogen
* A builder mindset: you wear several hats, audit CAD and P&IDs, and make fast, autonomous decisions
* Fluent English

* A strong sense for product design, and a tendency towards perfectionism

* Dutch

Jij maakt complexe zaken gemakkelijk inzichtelijk en hebt het vermogen om je in te beelden hoe je innovaties kunt toepassen in bestaande processen. Als je met voorstellen komt voor het verbeteren van de onderhoudsprocessen, kun je anderen overtuigen van de voordelen.
